independent_reference.source: Bohren & Huffman, Absorption and Scattering of Light by Small Particles, Ch. 8: normal-incidence infinite-cylinder coefficients b_n (TM, E parallel to axis = our TMz) and a_n (TE), e^{-iwt} convention; self-authored Bessel/Hankel generator (fdtd_optics.goldens.mie_cylinder).

Wiscombe MIEV0 sphere cross-anchor: the same scipy Bessel/Hankel machinery reproduces the published sphere table (fdtd-optics-mie-sphere-anchors.json, x=5.21282 m=1.55 -> 3.10543 +- 1e-5), proving the special-function core the cylinder series shares.
Lossless optical-theorem self-check Q_ext == Q_sca (< 1e-12 relative at every committed row), asserted in packages/fdtd-optics/tests/test_golden_tables.py.
